items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: We had a battle of music against Harry James.

ctx.x: Did you play that every night, "Rockin' Chair"?

No, that's the thing. I didn't play it every night. We probably played it at the wrong time, you know. Like, he pulled that on me once in the Palladium. We had a battle of music against Harry James. And that was a funny thing, man. All the things I had to play, he played nothing that I had to play all night long -- until the broadcast came. And way down in the broadcast, he's got "Rockin' Chair." And I had played very little Jazz all night long, which was rare for me, you know. In other words, it was like he…
